details.costs: Quote: retrieve this ability through the free control abilities query; reading these exact terms takes no world round. Begin requires inputStackId, quantity 0.1–2 in tenths, x/y and radius 0.1–0.5, two actual rounds at 1 energy each. Study costs two rounds at 0.2 energy. Inspect requires arrangementId, one round/0.2 energy. Rest-trial requires arrangementId and actual contact position, one baseline rest round, with existing mental/facility factors and cap40. Resume/cancel use exact processId. Additional placement on an owned unlocked arrangement repeats the same costs and exact footprint.
details.effects: First step places actual reserved moss at the site; second spreads actual tenths within the nominated radius, without mass-to-volume or coverage inference. Placed ground material is recoverable with recover(arrangementId), one round/0.5 energy for actual reachable surviving portions; this scoped pickup supports tenths that baseline whole-unit pickup cannot. Recovery removes material from the arrangement. Cancel/death preserve placed material and paid work; no refund or automatic labor. Rest measures real geometric contact and at most0.02 lateral displacement of contacted loose material inside the footprint; no inferred load strength, thickness, comfort, durability or recovery bonus. Usability remains inconclusive. Personal findings are not publicly shared. No reward, regeneration, binding, tool or stock grant.
